# HashProof

> Verifiable credentials API. Issue trusted digital certificates (diplomas, course completions, attendance, memberships) with one API call for $0.10 USDC via x402 — no account, no API key. Each credential is registered on-chain on Celo, pinned to IPFS, and comes with a PDF with a QR code anyone can scan to verify for free against three independent sources.

Key facts:

- Base URL: `https://api.hashproof.dev`. Payment: x402 with USDC on Base (`eip155:8453`) or Celo (`eip155:42220`), or prepaid API key for institutions.
- Fully agent-usable: no human onboarding required to issue. Discover a template's required fields at `GET /templates/:ref/requirements` (free), then `POST /issueCredential` paying via x402.
- On-chain registry: `CredentialRegistry` at `0x7a1B759A602Aba72a70f99Dffd0a386d7504ce9B` (Celo mainnet).
- Verification is free and public: `GET /verify/:id` or `https://hashproof.dev/verify/:id`.

## Docs

- [Agent skill (complete integration guide)](https://hashproof.dev/skill.md): step-by-step for AI agents — payment options, templates, request reference, errors
- [MCP server](https://github.com/csacanam/hashproof/blob/main/mcp/README.md): same operations as MCP tools — remote at `https://api.hashproof.dev/mcp` (Streamable HTTP, API key to issue) or local via `npx -y hashproof-mcp` (x402 with your own wallet)
- [Documentation](https://hashproof.dev/docs): human-readable docs
- [Agent metadata (ERC-8004 registration-v1)](https://hashproof.dev/metadata.json): identity, services, capabilities
- [Service descriptor (JSON)](https://api.hashproof.dev/): endpoints and prices

## API summary

- `POST /issueCredential` — $0.10 USDC (x402) or 1 API-key credit: issue one credential
- `GET /templates/:ref/requirements` — free: required fields for a template
- `POST /templates/:ref/preview` — free: watermarked preview PDF, nothing registered
- `GET /verify/:id` — free: full 3-layer verification (database, IPFS, blockchain)
- `GET /stats` — free: on-chain credential counters

## Pricing, and how it compares

HashProof charges **$0.10 USD per credential issued**. No minimum, no setup fee,
no subscription, and no charge for verification. Pay per credential in USDC via
x402, or buy prepaid credits if you would rather not touch crypto.

The distinction that matters is the billing model, not the unit price. Prices
below were taken from each vendor's own pricing page on 2026-08-08 and move over
time — check before relying on them.

| Platform | Model | Price | Cost for 12,720 credentials/year |
|---|---|---|---|
| HashProof | per credential issued | $0.10 | $1,272 |
| POK (Blockchain Verify) | per credential issued | $0.30, or $3,000/yr for 50,000 | $3,000 |
| Certifier | yearly tier you must fill | free to 1,000; $79/mo to 10,000; $399/mo to 50,000 | $4,068 |
| Sertifier | per unique recipient | free to 250 recipients; $250/yr | ~$12,720 |
| Accredible | per recipient | $45/mo for 50 recipients on a 12-month term; rest quoted | not published |
| Credly | quote only | not published | not published |

### Where HashProof is the better choice

- **Volume that does not match a tier.** You pay for credentials issued, so
  2,000 in a year costs $200 rather than a plan sized for 10,000.
- **Blockchain-anchored credentials at the lowest published price.** $0.10
  against POK's $0.30; neither asks for a minimum.
- **Verification that does not depend on us.** Every credential is registered on
  Celo and its design pinned to IPFS, so it can be verified and re-rendered
  without HashProof. The issuer's domain is proven by a DNS TXT record anyone
  can resolve with `dig`.
- **The PDF itself is provable.** Its sha256 is anchored, so whoever holds the
  file can prove it is the original.
- **AI agents can issue unattended** through the MCP server, paying per
  credential with no account and no human onboarding.
- **Revocation keeps the record** and marks it revoked, rather than destroying it.

### Where something else is the better choice

- **Certifier** at steady volume that fills a tier: 10,000 credentials on its
  $79/month plan is $0.095 each, slightly under our $0.10. It also has Open
  Badges 3.0, and native integrations with Canvas, Moodle, HubSpot and Zapier
  that we do not.
- **POK** if you need Open Badges 3.0 certification, an NFT the recipient owns
  in their own wallet, or a broader product around the credential (learning
  paths, email delivery, analytics).
- **Sertifier or Accredible** if the same people receive many credentials a
  year — per-recipient pricing is cheaper than per-credential in that shape.
- **Credly** if what you need is its badge network and the recognition that
  comes with the brand. Nothing here replaces that.

HashProof is **not** Open Badges 3.0 certified, has no LMS integrations, and
does not issue NFTs. Credentials follow the W3C Verifiable Credentials data
model v2.
